Requirement You have a bonded Trick Iron and access to a cyber-augment install (Arm slot).

Your Trick Iron is grafted into your arm — it can't be dropped, taken, or left behind.

You have your Trick Iron built directly into an Arm-slot cyber-augment instead of carried in a holster. It counts as both your bonded weapon and your Arm-slot augment for all purposes — it takes the Arm slot's Drift like any augment, but it cannot be disarmed, dropped, or physically separated from you short of the slot itself being removed. Drawing it for the first time each turn no longer requires an Interact.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Drift" (augment-slot resource) has no confirmed Foundry field; I did not locate the augment card schema to verify total absence versus just unfamiliarity (flagged in Open Questions). The free-first-draw clause alone would match but is inseparable from the larger unbuildable fusion mechanic. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to. Pure action-cost-to-free conversion with no secondary numeric effect -- matches the pre-confirmed absence directly (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/barbarian/level-14/vengeful-strike.json and .../shared-class-feats/level-2/quick-draw.json, both rules: []).
